findings.evidence: Exit codes: table restates generic meanings (0 success, 2 bad input, 1 write failed) the CLI already prints on stderr
findings.fix: Keep the project-specific rows (degraded_reason, restore_error, AIKIT-XAI status). Move the generic exit-code meanings to references/exit-codes.md or record the removal.

findings.evidence: Run the v2 flow is a numbered procedure plus tables; the only explicit thinking prompt is 'Before the first command, ask yourself'
findings.fix: Add one decision line before each write: trusted checkout, v1-written config, and whether needs_choice remains, so the procedure teaches the check rather than only the command.

findings.evidence: NEVER and Common mistakes name specific failures, but several reasons are 'refused (exit 2)' without the non-obvious why
findings.fix: On the recommend --out and needs_choice rows, add the one-line why (plan must not sit in the config dir it describes; apply refuses an unresolved choice) already used in the v2 flow prose.

findings.evidence: Subcommand reference is an always-loaded table of flags the CLI --help already prints
findings.fix: Point the agent at python3 "$ENTRYPOINT" <subcommand> --help for flags, and keep in SKILL.md only the flags whose meaning is not on the CLI (recommend --out refusal, plan-set --force).

findings.evidence: Call vocabulary lists many equal flags (--effort, --context, --escalate-runtime, --session-id, supervision flags) with no default path for a stop
findings.fix: State the default: read the AIKIT-XAI line and stop per ai-kit-cross-ai sections 6-8; use the flag list only when the owner asks to change a lane setting.

findings.evidence: 16 queries (8 should-trigger, 8 should-not); the negatives are unrelated tasks, not near-misses such as gsd-settings or gsd-config
findings.fix: Add about four queries: two more should-trigger phrasings that do not name the skill, and two should-not near-misses that ask for gsd-settings or gsd-config integration knobs.

findings.evidence: edge-v1-written-config lists files evals/files/v1-project/.planning/config.json; that path is not in the skill directory
findings.fix: Add the v1 config fixture under evals/files/v1-project/.planning/config.json, or point the eval at a fixture that exists and assert the keys it must keep.

findings.evidence: ArgumentParser supplies default --help and JSON stdout; tests/test_curated_config_script.py and the other listed modules exercise the runner and apply paths but do not invoke --help
findings.fix: Add one smoke test that runs the entrypoint with --help and inventory --help and checks exit 0 plus the trusted-checkout warning.

findings.evidence: opencode run --standalone is 'accepted by opencode v2.0.31' with no vendor URL or date checked
findings.fix: Cite the opencode CLI docs URL and the date checked, or replace the version claim with 'confirm with opencode run --help before relying on --standalone'.

findings.evidence: Limits 'verified as of 2026-10-23' and cursor-agent 2026.10.14-941492e name versions with no source URL
findings.fix: Add the cursor-agent release or changelog URL next to the version, or say the version was read from cursor-agent --version on that date.
